# temps_edge_rule (Resource)

A request filter the Temps proxy evaluates before a project's application: block, allow, challenge, redirect or log requests that match an expression.

New rules start in `log_only` mode, which records matches without acting; set `mode = "enforce"` once the rule matches what you expect. Rules are evaluated in `position` order and new rules go last.

An expression group with no children matches every request, so the provider refuses one.

Import with `<project_id>/<rule_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `edge_rules:read`, `edge_rules:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Block the admin area for everyone outside the office network. New rules
# start in log_only mode; switch to enforce once the matches look right.
resource "temps_edge_rule" "admin" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  name       = "admin from office only"
  mode       = "enforce"
  action     = "block"
  status     = 403
  body       = "Not available from this network."

  expression = jsonencode({
    combinator = "all"
    children = [
      { kind = "condition", field = "path", op = "starts_with", values = ["/admin"] },
      {
        kind       = "group"
        combinator = "none"
        children = [
          { kind = "condition", field = "ip", op = "in_cidr", values = ["203.0.113.0/24"] },
        ]
      },
    ]
  })
}

# Send old blog links to the new path, keeping the rest of the URL.
resource "temps_edge_rule" "blog" {
  project_id      = temps_project.web.id
  name            = "old blog"
  mode            = "enforce"
  action          = "redirect"
  status          = 301
  redirect_target = "/articles{path}?{query}"

  expression = jsonencode({
    combinator = "all"
    children   = [{ kind = "condition", field = "path", op = "starts_with", values = ["/blog/"] }]
  })
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) What a match does: one of `block`, `allow`, `challenge`, `redirect`, `log`.
- `expression` (String) Match expression as JSON: a group `{ combinator, children }` where `combinator` is `all`, `any` or `none` and each child is a condition (`{ kind = "condition", field, op, values, key, case_insensitive }`) or a nested group (`{ kind = "group", combinator, children }`), at most 4 levels deep. Use `jsonencode()`.
- `name` (String) Rule name, up to 80 characters.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project. Changing it replaces the rule.

### Optional

- `body` (String) For `block`: plain-text response body, up to 1024 bytes.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is evaluated. Defaults to `true`.
- `environment_id` (Number) Apply the rule to this environment only. Unset applies it to every environment of the project.
- `mode` (String) `log_only` (the default) records matches without acting; `enforce` acts on them.
- `redirect_target` (String) For `redirect`: a path starting with `/` or an absolute http(s) URL. `{path}` and `{query}` insert the request's path and query string.
- `status` (Number) Response status: 400-499 for `block` (default `403`), 301, 302, 307 or 308 for `redirect` (default `302`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric rule ID.
- `position` (Number) 0-based evaluation order.
- `revision` (Number) Edit counter. Updates send it, so a rule changed since the last refresh is refused instead of overwritten.
- `summary` (String) The rule in one sentence, as Temps describes it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import temps_edge_rule.admin 3/9
```
